title: RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke
summary: The server-assigned handler answering InvokeServer calls: OnServerInvoke = function(player, ...) return value end. Assigned like a property (not :Connect'd); must exist before clients invoke.

reference.signature: RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, ...args: any) ... return value end

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The invoking client — injected automatically, first parameter, unspoofable.

parameters.name: ...args
parameters.description: The client's InvokeServer arguments. Validate them.

reference.returns: Whatever you return is serialized and delivered back to the invoking client.

details.heading: Assigned, not connected
details.body: It's a property holding one function. Assigning twice replaces the handler. No multiple listeners like :Connect.

details.heading: Must exist early
details.body: If a client invokes before assignment, the invoke errors on the client. Assign at server startup.

explanation.whatItIs: The answering machine for client questions. Whatever you return flies back across the network to the waiting thread.
explanation.whyItExists: InvokeServer needs a destination; OnServerInvoke is that destination with a verified player attached.
whenToUse: Any legitimate request/response the client may wait on
whenNotToUse: For work that yields long (DataStore lookups) without caching — the client is blocked waiting
tips: Return quickly; offload slow work to cached data
Validate args exactly like OnServerEvent arguments
One handler per RemoteFunction — design the API with a 'request type' first argument
commonMistakes: Assigning in a LocalScript — no effect; server side only
Forgetting to assign at all — clients error on invoke
Yielding inside for seconds (blocking that client's request thread)

examples.title: Request-type dispatch
examples.code:
-- Server:
rf.OnServerInvoke = function(player, requestType, ...)
    if requestType == "Price" then
        local item = ...
        if typeof(item) ~= "string" then return nil end
        return PRICES[item]
    elseif requestType == "Level" then
        return getLevel(player)
    end
    return nil   -- unknown request
end

-- Client:
local price = rf:InvokeServer("Price", "Sword")
